title: FareEstimate
description: An estimated fare for a requested trip, typically returned in response to a search before the booking is confirmed. v2.1 adds offeredAmount, discountAmount, itemPrice, createdAt, updatedAt for V1 ONDC TRV10 round-trip.

fareBreakup.description: Itemised breakdown of the estimated fare

validity.description: Validity period or TTL of the offer

tags.description: Tags or labels associated with the offer

offeredAmount.description: The discounted or offered fare presented to the customer. Maps to V1 item.price.offered_value.

discountAmount.description: Discount amount applied to the fare. Maps to V1 items[].tags[OFFER_INFO].DISCOUNT_AMOUNT.

itemPrice.description: Per-item price breakdown. Maps to V1 item.price fields.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the order was created. Maps to V1 order.created_at.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the order was last updated. Maps to V1 order.updated_at.
